learnings.question: What sequence of actions is recommended to effectively retain personal insights and combat human forgetfulness?
options: Conduct passive re-reading, store notes in private filing cabinets, and avoid digital tools
Rely on raw memory, re-read old notes daily, and hoard written journals
Write thoughts down, build a system of reminders, and share the knowledge publicly
Memorize thoughts immediately, delete written drafts, and keep insights strictly confidential
learnings.learning: To counteract memory loss and ensure long-term retention of insights, individuals should stop relying solely on memory by writing thoughts down, establishing a system of reminders, and sharing the knowledge publicly.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which of the following job titles is NOT one of the three core roles defined within the Scrum framework?
learnings.learning: A common misconception in team management is assuming a Project Manager exists within Scrum; however, the framework officially defines only three core roles: Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Developers.

learnings.question: When analyzing word frequency in the Quran, what cumulative percentage of the total text do the top 20 most common words represent?
learnings.learning: Contrary to the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule), learning the top 20 most frequently occurring words in the Quran does not cover 80% of the text, but rather accounts for approximately 20.83% of it.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Which term refers to Allah's complete plan and eternal knowledge of everything that will ever happen in life?
learnings.learning: Qadr refers to Allah's complete plan and eternal knowledge of everything that will ever happen, encompassing all events written for a person's life.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: In Islamic teachings, what does the concept of 'taqwa' refer to?
options: The physical act of performing formal ritual prayers
The mandatory practice of giving financial charity
The complete withdrawal from community life
An awareness of Allah's presence that builds self-restraint and mindfulness
learnings.learning: In Islamic teachings, taqwa is defined as an awareness of Allah's presence that fosters mindfulness, builds self-restraint, and purifies one's intentions.
